title: Treatise of the Twin Ruin
summary: A treatise on ruin laid in pairs so the second ruin completes what the first began and ends in a dual annihilation.

title: The Azure Sundering Canon
summary: A canon of sundering the sky-sworn field and everything in it along its own lines of weakness.

title: The Dual-Track Dissolution Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of two tracks of unmaking qi run together one to dissolve the form of a thing and one to dissolve its force.

title: The Plateau Razing Canon
summary: A canon of levelling everything built on open ground with a few heavy sweeps of unmaking.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Bound Unmaking
summary: A treatise on unmaking sworn only against the one named and never against what the oath forbids.

title: Manual of the Windward Ruin
summary: A manual of ruin carried before the wind so that what stands upwind is unmade before the user arrives.
